# Components and request flows

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_architecture.py from libs/shared/src/ai_circus_shared/architecture_catalog.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

The [architecture guide](README.md) explains how these fit together. Optional components are off by default and switched on with the command in *How to switch it on*.

## Gateways and governance

Every door into the platform and every check on the way: the ingress, sign-in, entitlements, the gateway every model and agent call passes, and the admin control plane.

| Component | What it does | Technology | How to switch it on | ADR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Traefik** | The only way in from a browser: *.localhost hostnames to each service. The registry, gateway, Qdrant and Valkey are never exposed. | Traefik ingress | always on | — |
| **Keycloak** | Sign-in and tenants: a tenant is a Keycloak Organization, a scenario is a realm role; per-API token exchange for MCP servers. | Keycloak, OIDC | always on | [0021](../adr/0021-chat-ui-with-real-keycloak-sign-in.md), [0022](../adr/0022-mcp-server-kit-and-per-api-tokens.md) |
| **platform-registry** | Tenants, scenarios and entitlements, checked by every service before it answers; the audit trail and the AI-BOM. | FastAPI · SQLAlchemy | always on | [0008](../adr/0008-tenancy-and-access-policy.md), [0011](../adr/0011-governance-ready-by-standards.md) |
| **llm-gateway** | Every model call and every MCP tool call: routing, rate limits, per-tenant budgets, the policy decision point, the local embedding model and the MCP gateway. | LiteLLM proxy · sentence-transformers | always on | [0017](../adr/0017-vllm-alongside-ollama.md), [0020](../adr/0020-mcp-gateway-without-enterprise.md), [0024](../adr/0024-one-mcp-catalog.md) |
| **MCP server kit (crm-mcp)** | An MCP server in front of an existing API: validates the token, applies the tool policy, exchanges the token for the API's own, writes an audit line per call. | libs/mcp-kit · FastMCP | make k3s-mcp-examples-up | [0022](../adr/0022-mcp-server-kit-and-per-api-tokens.md), [0023](../adr/0023-observability-of-the-mcp-path.md), [0025](../adr/0025-level-3-regulated-mcp-servers.md), [0029](../adr/0029-pseudonymous-users-at-the-apis.md) |
| **Open Policy Agent** | An optional policy decision point the gateway can ask before a model call, with the policy as code. | OPA, Rego | make k3s-governance-opa-up | [0011](../adr/0011-governance-ready-by-standards.md) |
| **data-platform-manager** | The admin control plane behind the Platform page: health, resources, start and stop of optional workloads, the capability roadmap and governance switches. | FastAPI · Kubernetes API | always on | — |

## Consumption: AI, BI and GenAI

What people use: the web app, the model and chat services one instance per scenario kind, dashboards and chat UIs.

| Component | What it does | Technology | How to switch it on | ADR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **ui-react** | The web app: the scenario gallery, generic tabs driven by each scenario.yaml, the showpiece tabs, chat, voice, Settings and the admin Platform page. | React · Vite · CopilotKit · AG-UI | always on | — |
| **prediction** | Serves every tabular model: predictions with SHAP, forecasts and what-ifs, recommendations, the dataset sample and the model card, per tenant. | FastAPI · scikit-learn, LightGBM, SHAP | always on | — |
| **assistant** | The chat copilot of tabular and data scenarios: answers from tools (model, data, documents, analysis toolsets), never invents a figure, and serves a scenario's model to MCP clients. | FastAPI · LangChain · AG-UI · MCP | always on | [0031](../adr/0031-mcp-doors-on-the-assistant.md) |
| **rag-agent** | Answers questions grounded in a scenario's documents (RAG and GraphRAG), citing every passage, and serves them to MCP clients. | FastAPI · LangChain · Qdrant · MCP | always on | [0019](../adr/0019-mcp-doors-and-tool-policy.md) |
| **form-agent** | Fills a form through conversation, validates it, prints official PDFs and tracks each submission per user. | FastAPI · LangChain · ReportLab | always on | — |
| **agui-voice** | Voice mode: speech to text and text to speech around the same agents, over a WebSocket. | FastAPI · Pipecat · Whisper, Piper | On with make k3s-all; the lite profile scales it to zero (make k3s-full brings it back) | — |
| **dl-inference** | Serves the deep-learning models (images, text, camera frames) on CPU with ONNX Runtime. | FastAPI · ONNX Runtime | make k3s-dl-up | — |
| **Superset** | BI dashboards over a data product's marts, imported from the scenario's YAML. | Apache Superset, dashboards as code | make k3s-data-bi-up | [0009](../adr/0009-bi-superset.md) |
| **Open WebUI · LibreChat** | Off-the-shelf chat apps with Keycloak sign-in that reach the platform's tools only through the MCP gateway, with each user's token. | Open WebUI · LibreChat (MongoDB) | make k3s-chat-ui-up · make k3s-librechat-up | [0021](../adr/0021-chat-ui-with-real-keycloak-sign-in.md), [0026](../adr/0026-librechat-second-chat-ui.md) |

## Data

Where data lives and how it gets there: object storage, databases and vectors, the jobs that clean data, train models and index documents, and the optional streaming data platform.

| Component | What it does | Technology | How to switch it on | ADR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **SeaweedFS** | Datasets, trained models, documents, MLflow artifacts, the data platform's landing zone and Iceberg lake, every key prefixed by tenant. | S3-compatible object storage | always on | — |
| **PostgreSQL** | Keycloak, tenants and entitlements, chat history, form submissions, Langfuse and MLflow metadata, and the data platform's bronze and marts. | PostgreSQL | always on | — |
| **Valkey** | Cache: sessions, rate-limit and budget counters of llm-gateway, Langfuse's queue. | Valkey (Redis protocol) | always on | — |
| **Qdrant** | One vector collection per scenario and tenant: the passages RAG and form assistants search. | Qdrant vector database | always on | — |
| **ClickHouse** | Langfuse's trace store, and the data platform's analytical marts on the analytics tier. | ClickHouse | always on | — |
| **etl-tabular** | Cleans each tabular scenario's dataset, applies its business rules and data-quality policy, and writes the processed copy. | k8s Job · pandas, pyarrow | make k3s-pipeline | — |
| **training** | Trains every candidate, picks the model by its metric (simpler wins within a margin), writes the model, its card and out-of-fold scores. | k8s Job · scikit-learn, LightGBM, SHAP | make k3s-pipeline | — |
| **etl-vectorize** | Chunks each scenario's documents, embeds them through llm-gateway and writes them to the tenant's Qdrant collection. | k8s Job · chunking, embeddings | make k3s-vectorize | — |
| **dl-training** | Fine-tunes the deep-learning scenarios (NLP, computer vision, anomaly detection) and exports ONNX models. | k8s Job or host GPU · PyTorch, exported to ONNX | make k3s-dl-train SCENARIO=<slug> | — |
| **Kafka** | The event backbone of a data product: a topic per contract and tenant, fed by its simulator and by change capture. | Kafka 3.9 KRaft | make k3s-data-core-up | [0003](../adr/0003-event-backbone-and-contracts.md) |
| **data-ingest** | Validates every record against its contract, upserts it idempotently into bronze, quarantines what fails, archives to the Iceberg lake and keeps the live aggregates. | FastAPI · consumers | make k3s-data-core-up | [0004](../adr/0004-bronze-and-lakehouse.md), [0012](../adr/0012-hot-path.md) |
| **data-transform** | Builds silver and gold from bronze with tested dbt models; the marts the dashboards and the API read. | dbt · CronJob | make k3s-data-core-up | [0006](../adr/0006-transformation-and-orchestration.md) |
| **Dagster** | Orchestrates the transformations with sensors, lineage and checks on the analytics tier. | Dagster | make k3s-data-analytics-up | [0006](../adr/0006-transformation-and-orchestration.md) |
| **data-api** | The governed door to a data product: records, search, metrics, read-only SQL and live events, filtered by tenant first, then the role's rows and masks. | FastAPI · REST, SSE, MCP | make k3s-data-core-up | [0007](../adr/0007-serving-api-assistant-mcp.md), [0008](../adr/0008-tenancy-and-access-policy.md), [0019](../adr/0019-mcp-doors-and-tool-policy.md) |
| **OpenMetadata** | The data catalogue: owners, lineage and tests of every dataset, kept in sync by a Job. | OpenMetadata · Elasticsearch | make k3s-data-governance-up | [0010](../adr/0010-governance-openmetadata.md) |
| **crm-api** | An example business API (customers of the shops) that an MCP server is put in front of, with its own token audience. | FastAPI | make k3s-mcp-examples-up | [0022](../adr/0022-mcp-server-kit-and-per-api-tokens.md) |

## Infrastructure

The cluster everything runs on: Kubernetes (k3s, or k3d on a laptop), its volumes, and an optional GPU node for local models.

| Component | What it does | Technology | How to switch it on | ADR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Kubernetes (k3s)** | Runs every workload as a pod in the ai-circus namespace, with requests, limits, probes and non-root containers. | k3s · k3d on Docker for a laptop | always on | — |
| **GPU node** | Lends the host GPU to deep-learning training, local models (vLLM) and GPU telemetry. | NVIDIA device plugin, host GPU | make k3s-cluster K3S_GPU=1 · make k3s-gpu-telemetry | — |
| **vLLM** | Serves an open-weights LLM on the GPU behind llm-gateway, so a model can run without a cloud provider. | vLLM, OpenAI-compatible | make k3s-vllm-up | [0017](../adr/0017-vllm-alongside-ollama.md) |
| **LLM providers** | The models themselves, outside the cluster. Only llm-gateway ever calls them. | OpenAI · Anthropic · Google · Groq · DeepSeek · Ollama | external | — |

## Observability

Metrics, logs and traces of every service, plus the AI-specific monitors: a trace per LLM call and a record per training run.

| Component | What it does | Technology | How to switch it on | ADR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Langfuse** | A trace per LLM call by tenant, scenario and conversation, fed only by llm-gateway. | Langfuse v4 (web, worker) | always on | — |
| **MLflow** | Every training run's candidates, scores and the selected model; never allowed to fail a training job. | MLflow | always on | — |
| **OpenTelemetry collector** | Receives every service's traces and logs over OTLP, masks tokens and emails in log lines, forwards them. | OpenTelemetry collector | make k3s-obs-up | [0015](../adr/0015-observability-platform-contract.md), [0028](../adr/0028-masked-logs-and-one-trace-through-the-mcp-hop.md) |
| **VictoriaMetrics** | Scrapes every service's /metrics and evaluates the alert rules. | VictoriaMetrics · vmalert | make k3s-obs-up | [0015](../adr/0015-observability-platform-contract.md) |
| **Loki** | Stores the JSON log lines, each with its trace id. | Grafana Loki | make k3s-obs-up | — |
| **Tempo** | Stores the content-free traces, including one trace across the MCP hop. | Grafana Tempo | make k3s-obs-up | [0028](../adr/0028-masked-logs-and-one-trace-through-the-mcp-hop.md) |
| **Grafana** | Dashboards for the LLM gateway (calls, tokens, cost, latency), GPUs, model drift and the MCP path. | Grafana | make k3s-obs-up | — |

## Request flows

### A prediction, explained

A user scores one record in a model tab.

1. **ui-react → Traefik**: POST /predict/{scenario} with the user's token
2. **Traefik → prediction**: routed by hostname
3. **prediction → Keycloak**: token checked (signature, organization)
4. **prediction → platform-registry**: is this tenant entitled to this scenario?
5. **prediction → SeaweedFS**: the tenant's model, already loaded at start-up
6. **prediction → ui-react**: probability and SHAP contributions

### A question to the assistant

A user asks a tabular scenario's assistant something about the data or the model.

1. **ui-react → Traefik**: AG-UI run, streamed
2. **Traefik → assistant**: routed by hostname
3. **assistant → platform-registry**: entitlement
4. **assistant → llm-gateway**: the model decides which tool to call
5. **llm-gateway → LLM providers**: the active model (rate limit and budget checked)
6. **assistant → prediction**: the tool's call: predict, explain, forecast
7. **llm-gateway → Langfuse**: one trace per model call
8. **assistant → ui-react**: the answer, a chart, the tools it used

### A question answered from documents

A user asks something the scenario's documents answer.

1. **ui-react → rag-agent**: the question, through Traefik
2. **rag-agent → llm-gateway**: embed the question (local-embed)
3. **rag-agent → Qdrant**: the tenant's collection: nearest passages
4. **rag-agent → llm-gateway**: answer from those passages only
5. **rag-agent → ui-react**: the answer with every passage cited

### From raw data to a served model

The pipeline every tabular scenario runs once (make k3s-pipeline).

1. **etl-tabular → SeaweedFS**: raw dataset in, cleaned dataset out
2. **training → SeaweedFS**: reads the cleaned data, writes model, card, out-of-fold scores
3. **training → MLflow**: every candidate and its score
4. **prediction → SeaweedFS**: loads the new model on restart

### A record through the data platform

A sale happens in a shop of a data-product scenario.

1. **Kafka → data-ingest**: the event, on its contract's topic
2. **data-ingest → PostgreSQL**: validated, upserted into bronze (or quarantined)
3. **data-transform → PostgreSQL**: dbt builds silver and gold
4. **data-api → PostgreSQL**: metrics and records, filtered by role
5. **data-api → ui-react**: the live dashboard and the governed doors

### The same question from an external chat (MCP)

A user asks in LibreChat or Open WebUI; the answer needs a tool of the platform.

1. **Open WebUI · LibreChat → Keycloak**: the user signs in
2. **Open WebUI · LibreChat → llm-gateway**: the MCP gateway, with the user's token
3. **llm-gateway → MCP server kit (crm-mcp)**: the tool call, if the user's group may run it
4. **MCP server kit (crm-mcp) → Keycloak**: exchanges the token for one valid only for crm-api
5. **MCP server kit (crm-mcp) → crm-api**: the call, as a pseudonym, over mutual TLS at level 3
6. **MCP server kit (crm-mcp) → OpenTelemetry collector**: an audit line and one trace across the hop
